items.body: The Snake Corps’ cult classic debut Flesh on Flesh is back in physical circulation, with the album newly reissued in two 2026 editions: an expanded and remastered CD from Iconoclassic Records and a clear-vinyl pressing from Lantern Rec. Originally issued on Midnight Music in 1985, Flesh on Flesh captures the English band’s early sound in full reach: ringing guitars, hard-edged romanticism, cavernous drums, and the kind of widescreen emotional pull that placed them in the same weather system as Sad Lovers & Giants, The Chameleons, The Sound, Echo & the Bunnymen, and early U2. But where Sad Lovers & Giants often leaned toward a more misted, coldwave-adjacent strain of post-punk, The Snake Corps pushed the shared DNA into something heavier and more gothic-rock-inclined, with a sharper guitar attack and a larger, more anthemtic vocal presence. That presence belongs to Marc Lewis, whose voice gives Flesh on Flesh much of its force. Lewis sings with a dramatic, open-throated command that rivals Bono at his early-80s peak, turning songs such as “Victory Parade,” “Science Kills,” “Another Monday,” and “Look East for Eden” into broad, urgent statements without losing the record’s underground charge. The Snake Corps could brood with the best of their era, but they also knew how to make that brooding move outward, toward scale, sweep, and grandeur. The new Iconoclassic edition, catalog number ICON 1093, marks the album’s first CD pressing in more than 35 years. It has been remastered by Maria Triana and expanded with seven bonus tracks, three of which appear on CD for the first time. The package also includes new liner notes by Mick Mercer, based on newly conducted interviews with the band. A separate Lantern Rec. edition, issued for Record Store Day 2026, brings Flesh on Flesh back to LP as a limited clear-vinyl pressing with one bonus track, “Dreamland.” The Snake Corps formed around 1984 in the wake of the first breakup of Sad Lovers & Giants, with guitarist Tristan Garel-Funk and drummer Nigel Pollard initially launching the project. Pollard soon returned to Sad Lovers & Giants, and the early Snake Corps lineup solidified around Marc Lewis on vocals, Garel-Funk on guitar, Liam McGuinness on bass, and Jon Greville of Rudimentary Peni on drums. The connection between the two bands was not merely biographical. The Snake Corps and Sad Lovers & Giants shared a musical bloodstream, sometimes quite literally: songs such as “In Flux” passed between both their worlds, revealing how close the projects could be in origin while showing how differently each band handled the same material. In the hands of Sad Lovers & Giants, that language could feel spectral, icy, and suspended in another world; with The Snake Corps, it became denser and darker. Still dreamy, yet more forceful. Though Flesh on Flesh never became a mainstream hit, the record built a devoted following among post-punk, darkwave, and gothic-rock fans, particularly in Europe, where The Snake Corps found much of their audience through touring. They later continued with albums including Smother Earth and 3rd Cup, and eventually returned to activity in the 2010s, carrying forward the same grand, bruised romanticism that made their debut such a cult favorite. items._cn_summary: The Snake Corps 1985年首张专辑《Flesh on Flesh》由独立厂牌Iconoclassic Records和Lantern Rec.再版发行。文章属于再版资讯/新闻稿性质，主要介绍了专辑再版的版本细节（CD扩充版含七首bonus track、清晰黑胶版），并简要追溯了乐队从Sad Lovers & Giants分裂出来的历史脉络。音乐风格定位为后朋克与哥特摇滚的交叉地带，以回响吉他、深沉鼓点和宽广情感张力为核心特征，主唱Marc Lewis的演绎被类比早期Bono。整体而言是传统后朋克/暗潮类型作品，与用户暗潮偏好有一定契合，但文章缺乏对音乐创新性或实验元素的深入探讨，且本质为唱片再版的宣传性文本。

items.artist: The Durutti Column Announce First Studio LP in Over 15 Years, “Renascent”
items.excerpt: Legendary Manchester post-punk act The Durutti Column have announced Renascent, their first new studio album in 16 years. The new record, led once again by the unmistakable guitar work of Vini Reilly, is due this summer via London Records, with Bandcamp currently listing the digital release for July 10 and physical editions shipping around July 31. The album follows 2010’s A Paean to Wilson and arrives after the recent expanded reissue campaign surrounding the band’s Factory Records-era catalog.
items.body: Legendary Manchester post-punk act The Durutti Column have announced Renascent, their first new studio album in 16 years. The new record, led once again by the unmistakable guitar work of Vini Reilly, is due this summer via London Records, with Bandcamp currently listing the digital release for July 10 and physical editions shipping around July 31. The album follows 2010’s A Paean to Wilson and arrives after the recent expanded reissue campaign surrounding the band’s Factory Records-era catalog. Alongside Reilly, Renascent features longtime Durutti Column percussionist Bruce Mitchell and producer/multi-instrumentalist Keir Stewart. The album also includes guest vocal turns from a newer generation of artists, including Caoilfhionn Rose on “Agonistes” and Lucas Elliot on the CD and digital bonus track “All They See Is Fire.” To mark the announcement, The Durutti Column have shared the first single, “Liars,” a graceful return set to a low, downtempo beat with a faint trip-hop sway and a touch of dream-pop atmosphere. Reilly’s smoky, close-miked vocals are counterbalanced by feminine sighs and warm electronic washes, but the center remains that guitar: clean, fluid, and instantly recognizable, with elaborate yet controlled melodic phrases that breathe like poetry. His riffs seem to carry decades of feeling without overplaying a single bar, leaving “Liars” suspended between recollection and motion, tender without becoming fragile, delicate without disappearing. This is unmistakably The Durutti Column: a sound built from restraint, ache, and Reilly’s gift for turning the smallest melodic gesture into an emotional event. Watch the official visualizer for “Liars” below. Pre-orders for Renascent are available now on CD, vinyl, cassette, digital, and deluxe formats. The album’s visual presentation also nods back to the group’s Factory lineage, with artwork from longtime Factory design collaborators Mark Holt and Hamish Muir of 8vo. Listen to “Liars” via Bandcamp below, and pre-order Renascent here. Renascent by The Durutti Column Formed in Manchester in 1978, The Durutti Column occupies the first page of Factory Records history. Vini Reilly would later describe the group as Tony Wilson’s “baby”: the first act signed up to the Factory club night and the first band signed to Factory Records. They would also appear on A Factory Sample, Factory’s first record release, alongside Joy Division, Cabaret Voltaire, and John Dowie. The original lineup soon splintered, leaving Reilly as the project’s center of gravity. His clean, fluid, emotionally exact playing stood apart from the harsher edges of the era. Where many of his contemporaries turned alienation into abrasion, Reilly found tension in delicacy. His music traced quiet lines through jazz, classical phrasing, ambient space, and the private weather of memory, creating a body of work that felt less like a reaction against rock orthodoxy than an escape route from it. The group’s 1980 debut, The Return of the Durutti Column, recorded with producer Martin Hannett, remains one of the great anomalies of the Factory catalog: a record as hushed and human as its infamous sandpaper sleeve was antagonistic. Inspired by Situationist mischief, the original sleeve was designed to scuff whatever sat beside it on the shelf, with early copies hand-assembled by members of the Factory circle, including Joy Division. It was a typically Factory contradiction: beauty housed in sabotage, gentleness wrapped in damage. Across the decades that followed, Reilly continued to steer The Durutti Column through a deeply individual body of work, often joined by longtime percussionist Bruce Mitchell and, in more recent years, producer and multi-instrumentalist Keir Stewart. Albums such as LC, Another Setting, Without Mercy, The Guitar and Other Machines, and Vini Reilly moved between instrumental miniatures, chamber-like arrangements, electronic textures, and songs that seemed to arrive from some half-remembered interior place. The Durutti Column never fit comfortably inside post-punk’s usual frame, which is exactly why their work continues to feel so singular. Reilly’s touch also reached beyond The Durutti Column. In 1988, he played guitar and keyboards on Morrissey’s solo debut Viva Hate, bringing a glassy, mercurial Manchester language to the record. His iconic guitar on “Suedehead” remains one of the song’s defining features: that instantly recognizable opening figure, ringing out with a clarity that helped announce Morrissey’s post-Smiths life while quietly carrying Reilly’s own signature into the charts. Whatever arguments have followed the album’s credits over the years, the sound of Reilly’s guitar on that single is unmistakable. In recent years, The Durutti Column’s influence has continued to travel in unexpected directions, with younger artists and listeners finding their way into Reilly’s catalog through reissues, rediscovery, and word-of-mouth devotion. The music has always carried that kind of private magnetism: understated, deeply felt, and resistant to easy summary. With Renascent, The Durutti Column return not as a relic from Manchester’s post-punk mythology, but as a living presence within it: still tender, still strange, still guided by Reilly’s unmistakable hand. Renascent Tracklist Echoes in the Memory Your Shadow at Morning Time Present and Time Past Agonistes Liars Vapour in a Matchbox Your Shadow at Evening Sargasso Sea Scammer For Friends Everywhere All They See Is Fire — CD and digital bonus track Follow The Durutti Column: Official Website Instagram Facebook Bandcamp Spotify The post The Durutti Column Announce First Studio LP in Over 15 Years, “Renascent” — Listen to New Song “Liars” appeared first on Post-Punk.com.
items._cn_summary: Durutti Column宣布发行新专辑《Renascent》，距离上一张录音室专辑已逾十六年。主创Vini Reilly延续其标志性的吉他风格，融合爵士乐句、古典语汇、氛围空间与细腻情感表达。新单曲《Liars》呈现慢速downtempo节拍，融入trip-hop律动与dream-pop氛围，辅以电子音效与人声点缀。专辑由伦敦唱片公司发行，长期合作打击乐手Bruce Mitchell与制作人Keir Stewart参与，邀来Caoilfhionn Rose与Lucas Elliot客串献声。封面设计由Factory厂牌时期合作设计师Mark Holt与Hamish Muir操刀，延续该团体与Factory Records的历史渊源。整体音乐定位为内敛的后朋克向氛围音乐延伸，强调克制、忧郁与精致旋律的结合。

items.body: Grammy-nominated guitarist Alex Wintz is not only a frequent performer, both with his own group and with artists such as the trumpeters Etienne Charles and Jeremy Pelt and trombonist Nick Finzer, but also an educator on the faculty of the New Jersey Performing Arts Center Jazz for Teens program and a clever composer. Collage features six excellent original tunes along with the jazz standard "The Shadow of Your Smile" and George Harrison's "Isn't It A Pity" and follows Wintz's two prior releases as a leader, LifeCycle (Culture Shock Music, 2017) and the very well-regarded Live To Tape (Outside in Music, 2020). Wintz's outstanding band on this date—all of whom, like the leader, trained at the Berklee College of Music and/or Julliard School—features bassist Matt Penman, nimble drummer Jimmy Macbride and pianist Victor Gould. Collage is a continually engaging album of superb compositions played with taste, groove and swing. Wintz gets a beautiful, pellucid tone from his Collings semi-hollow, heard immediately in album opener "Pondhop," inspired by the guitarist's international travels. Gould sits out this one, allowing Macbride's prominent tom accents and snare cross-sticking to drive this blues- based tune with a sunny West African twist to its prominent melody. The addition of Gould's piano vamp gives the gently swinging "Apt. 3C" a melancholy underpinning over which Wintz weaves a wistful melody that seems to invoke memories of past homes while moving into a new one. When Penman's deep-toned bass moves into a walking pattern under Gould's beautiful solo, Macbride's swing becomes jaunty, and the leader's own solo develops into one of his best on the record. Album highlight, "Innings Eater," begins with a meaty bass solo before settling into a wicked 5/4 groove eliciting wonderful interaction between the trio of Wintz, Penman, and Macbride. Special mention here should be made of the drummer's beautifully-tuned and well-recorded kit, with every subtle tom roll and hi-hat dynamic clear and present. Gould's piano returns for the bouncy "Better Half," dedicated to—who else?—Wintz's wife Francesca. It is a lovely tune of muted riffs, harmonically rich chord progressions and well-placed pauses that sound like the punctuation at the end of the conversation's sentences. In "The Wheels of Justice," a kind of modified blues waltz for the core trio, Wintz puts on a clinic of classic modern jazz guitar playing, pausing towards the end to give Penman and a chance to shine in his subtle solo before trading fours with Macbride. Complementing Wintz's excellent original tunes is a refreshingly funky take on Johnny Mandel's "The Shadow of Your Smile" and "Isn't It A Pity," in which the core trio avoids the rather dirge-like feel of Harrison's original, instead adopting a wry groove that will have listeners dancing the despair away. Deserving of a wide hearing, Collage is a superb jazz guitar record featuring Wintz's memorable tunes played with finesse by a talented, sympathetic band.
items._cn_summary: 这是一张以原声吉他为主导的现代爵士专辑，吉他手Alex Wintz毕业于伯克利音乐学院与朱利亚音乐学院，师承传统爵士语汇。专辑收录六首原创作品，外加爵士标准曲《The Shadow of Your Smile》与George Harrison的《Isn't It A Pity》的改编。乐队配置为传统爵士四重奏——吉他、钢琴、贝斯与鼓，演奏风格以摇摆律动、蓝调基底为主，偶有西非音乐元素点缀（如开篇曲中的西非旋律动机）。整体制作注重音色质感和室内乐般的精致互动，强调旋律优美与和声丰富，属于学术训练背景下的主流现代爵士范畴，在实验性与前卫性方面较为保守。

items.body:
DINTE dip into a rich archival pot of 1930’s-1950’s rural Greek demotika, a style of folksong rooted in the Byzantine era and practised between Greece and its diaspora.

Timeless themes of love, death, matrimony, nature and whatever is the Greek word for “the craic”, spur the singers on board to a range of keening laments of the slower Syrtos style, and ecstatic folk dance of the Pidiktos mode, in time-honoured style across ‘Curse You, Foreign Lands’.

While those themes may only be literally understood by Greek speakers, the songs’ passionately emotive delivery transcends tongues, variously mesmerising on the swaying, forlorn romance of Georgia Vasilopoulou, and male/female vocal in the heady helix of Nikolaos Chalkias’ ‘Σταφύλι μοσχοστάφυλο’, which kinda reminds us of Thai molam, or instrumentally emoting as on two standouts by Vaios Malliaras, while saving a drum and horn-led gem for Kostas Zografos’ ‘Ανάπλι στο βουλευτικό’.
items._cn_summary: 这是一张来自希腊的档案型民谣合辑，收录1930至1950年代乡村demotika风格作品，根源可追溯至拜占庭时期。专辑呈现该传统中关于爱情、死亡、婚姻与自然等主题的歌唱，涵盖Syrtos挽歌式吟唱与Pidiktos欢快民间舞曲。评论提及歌手Georgia Vasilopoulou的摇摆怅惘浪漫曲调、Chalkias的双人声螺旋对唱（被比作泰国molam）以及演奏家Malliaras与Zografos的器乐亮点。音乐本身为纯粹的传统民谣档案，无实验性或当代融合元素，但具有鲜明的希腊地域文化深度与历史厚重感。作为世界音乐范畴的合辑，对关注传统民间音乐与文化档案的听众具有参考价值。

items.body:
Ditching the free jazz, at least for a spell, sax prodigy Zoh Amba follows their blistering deployments for Smalltown and Tzadik and collaborations with Wobbly, Chris Corsano and Bill Orcutt with an album of fragile indie Americana. Unexpected, for sure, but welcome - RIYL 'Eureka'-mode Jim O'Rourke, early Joanna Newsom, Bonnie 'Prince' Billy or Bill Callahan.

Still in their mid-20s, Amba has already lived a lifetime on the US improv scene, releasing so many records in the space of the last half-decade that it's easy to understand why they needed some downtime. The story goes that they were back in their hometown of Kingsport, Tennessee - the birthplace of horror legend Nick Castle, who played Michael Myers in the first 'Halloween' - when they were inspired to drop their horn and tinker with their old acoustic guitar, the first instrument they learned to play, way back when. The instrument itself isn't really the most unexpected thing about 'Eyes Full', though, most surprising is the way Amba approaches it. Although they're a seasoned free improv fixture, there's none of the expected aesthetics on show here; quite the opposite, in fact, the album sounds as if it's barely aware that Albert Ayler existed, instead spying classic Appalachian folk, Nashville alt-country and headsy indie-rock for its creative Cliff's Notes. 

Listen in carefully though and you'll be able to identify the same eccentric energy that coursed through last year's excellent 'Sun'. Amba's voice is immediately a draw, molded into a drawl of elongated vowels and half-tuned syllables that sounds as if it's locked into a lineage that you can easily trace back to Alan Lomax's American folk field recordings. And their performance on the guitar seems to work to accent that distinct phrasing, indebted to John Fahey and his acolytes in a way, but also purposefully rough around the edges, punk-y, even. There's something about the way Amba is able to stab at the strings and turn the guitar into a percussive instrument for a second before lurching it back to melody that betrays their background. And their choice of collaborators is also key: they're backed up on 'Eyes Full' by drummer Jim White and their bestie Kevin Hyland on electric guitar, and the songs evolved through session after session of rehearsals. 

So there's a tightness here that's somehow shaped into pop that's ragged enough to feel fresh, vital and different. Lead single 'Another Time' will help you understand what planet they're on, with Amba's tactile strums and throaty intimacies wrapped casually around their collaborators' chic scaffolding. "In another lifetime, I take you to the sea," they half-screech. "I show you honey, how sweet that soul's meant to be." And on 'Southern Soil', they reflect on the history of small town, working class folk music in America, taking the lead with an acrobatic vocal performance that sounds as if it belongs in church. Even if you're missing the old Amba, there's a glimmer of improv running through 'Child You'll See' just for the heads, when their jangling guitar is swallowed by filthy reverb trails and supplanted by drones and pained sax wails. Very nice.
items._cn_summary: 萨克斯即兴演奏家Zoh Amba暂别自由爵士领域，转向原声吉他与独立美国民谣路线。专辑以田纳西故乡为背景，融合阿巴拉契亚民间音乐、纳什维尔另类乡村及独立摇滚元素，嗓音带有田野录音般的拖腔与半音节感，吉他演奏受John Fahey影响却刻意保持粗糙朋克质感，偶尔将弦乐器转化为打击乐器。合作者包括鼓手Jim White与吉他手Kevin Hyland，编曲松散中透出紧凑感。尽管创作者根植于自由即兴圈层，此作风格更接近Jim O'Rourke、Joanna Newsom式的内敛独立民谣，而非其擅长的实验爵士领域。

items.body:
True skool Chicago house don Mark Grusane packs inch-tight jakbeat budge and hypnotic depth on a definitive 6-track statement for his label, Disctechno and FFO Traxx, Adonis, Jamal Moss

A Windy City staple who has been DJing since the early ‘90s, and producing for over 20 years, Grusane’s experienced touch is tangible on all six tracky jams of ‘A House of My Own’. It’s a low-key masterclass in finding variation within a style, working the ruddiest bass and reedy synths to the bone on the title tune, and going tripper with it on ‘Essence of Life (Afterhours Mix)’, with over-the-shoulder vocals that are removed on its brighter ‘Daytime Mix’, and replaced with weird chirrups. He brings the acid to a gnarly simmer on the cold beat track ‘Knock Knock, Who’s There’, and taps a classic vein of Chi darkroom smut in the NSFW ace ‘Love and Lust (Explicit Lyrics)’, beside the filthy buck of ‘Jack Your Ass’.
items._cn_summary: 这是一张来自芝加哥的地下浩室音乐专辑，由资深DJ兼制作人Mark Grusane操刀，发行于独立厂牌Disctechno。专辑共收录六首曲目，风格扎根于芝加哥浩室传统，融合了酸浩室、深层浩室及锐舞浩室元素，呈现紧凑的节拍与催眠式的纵深感。制作手法扎实，在低音线和合成器的运用上展现出丰富的变化，从粗粝的贝斯线到迷幻的氛围铺陈都有所涉及。编曲强调律动感与俱乐部适用性，整体取向偏向功能性舞曲而非实验性声音探索。在创新性上更注重对既有风格的深化而非突破，与纯粹实验电子、前卫即兴或跨领域融合的方向有一定距离。适合浩室音乐爱好者及电子舞曲场景中的实用需求。

items.body:
Someone had to do it: Ennio Morricone and co.’s creepy OST for Pier Paolo Pasolini’s scandalous ’75 film rendition of the notorious novel ‘120 Days of Sodom’, by Marquis De Sade, lands on arch industrialist label, Cold Spring. Mangia!

Next in the label’s line of cult scores, after ‘Decoder’ and Psychic TV’s ‘A Prayer for Derek Jarman’, comes this deeply uneasy score to Pasolini’s infamous enactment of De Sade’s pornographic dystopia-come-study of male power dynamics. Whether you’ve seen it or not, the book and film’s reputation precedes them as both a piece of pure, unadulterated filth, or handy encyclopaedia of depravity, depending on one’s take. Each to their own, as one might say, but fuck me: without going into snuff or dark web realms, the imagery is about as mad as it gets. Which all makes the soundtrack of breezy to discordant chamber classical (Bach, Chopin, Orff, Puccini, and Graziosi) and parlour jazz arrangements register even harder in the memory, especially when paired with its scenes representing everything from coprophilia to bestiality, incest, and worse.
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑是埃尼奥·莫里科内等人为帕索里尼1975年争议电影《萨罗》配乐的原声带，由英国地下厂牌Cold Spring发行。音乐内容以室内古典为主，涵盖巴赫、肖邦、奥尔夫、普契尼及格拉齐奥西等作曲家的作品，辅以沙龙爵士编曲，呈现出从轻快到不协和的多元质感。与电影中极端暴虐的影像形成强烈反差，这种刻意的美学错位是该作品的核心艺术策略。作为冷门电影配乐，具有一定的当代古典与暗潮文化交叉属性，厂牌的地下工业背景也为其增添了几分实验色彩，但音乐本体仍以传统古典曲目为核心，原创性与声音实验层面相对有限。

Crackshot rap x club hybridiser Andrea Corradi splices dozens female spitters and mutant beats on ‘Outtakes’, the 2nd of his tapes for Reel Torque - Big RIYL DJ Screw, Rabit, Bobby Beethoven, Croww, Clams Casino, Hud Mo, Shadetek...

After his first volume sold out in a minute, Italian sound artist Andrea Corradi returns with a heat-seeking follow-up, shelling a 90 minute carousel of exclusive edits on tape, replete with a bonus 31 digital components for the DJs on an included download. It’s a rowdy cut ’n splice ram-raid that imagines; what would X rapper sound like on Y beat? The abundant results explore myriad permutations of this rudely unbalanced equation, from aggro jit paired with double speed fire, to Cerwin Vega-testing subs squashed with bitchiest bars, and genuine WTF‽ juxtapositions that go incredibly hard. 

The title ‘Outtakes’ knowingly undersells the prime material inside, which hits wider and just as rude as the ‘Ichinoya’ motherload which reached Mary Anne Hobbs’ BBC Radio 6 show and rinsed The White Hotel earlier this year. All the material lives up to expectations, firing from-the-hip mercurial fusions of underground, female rappers with leading-edge club ructions, with particular focus on mapping mutual, metric sweetspots between tunes that were never supposed to go together, but clearly work a treat. 

It’s effectively one of the canniest exercises in locating the mythical “3rd track” that we’ve heard in a hot minute, nailing the transitory pleasure of on-the-fly blends with a game sense of daring and rude empathy that rewards many happy returns in its spectrum of surprises - especially if you’ve had a keen ear on these pages over the years.

TIP!
items._cn_summary: 意大利声音艺术家Andrea Corradi的磁带作品，以剪辑拼贴手法将大量女性说唱歌手的声音与变异节拍进行激进重组，探索不同律动之间的碰撞可能。作品呈现九十年代南方说唱扭曲美学与俱乐部节拍的混合，引用DJ Screw、Clams Casino等制作人作为参考，体现出IDM与地下嘻哈之间的制作语汇。发行于独立厂牌Reel Torque，包含磁带与数字下载部分。作为实验性嘻哈/俱乐部融合作品，其制作手法具有前卫电子的探索特质，但整体以说唱为核心框架，与纯电子实验或前卫爵士方向存在一定距离。

items.body:
After the cataclysm of their Om debut, Al Cisneros & Chris Hakius come right down with its hypnotic follow-up, now returned to circulation on its 20th anniversary FFO Sleep, Earth, Popol Vuh.

‘Conference of the Birds’ (2006) had big boots to fill after Om’s immense 2005 debut ‘Variations on a Theme’, so they effectively slipped into a pair of sandals instead, feeling the sand between their toes on a pair of more desert oriented jams. Still squinting at durational horizons, they take all the time needed - up to and over 15 mins per side - to concentrate on more brooding strains of modal, psych-inflected stoner rock that works it magic more subtly. 

The hairy nads-out appeal of their previous side, and the grungier tone of their earlier, cult work as Sleep is swapped out for mantric, pentatonic riffs and sway that channel the blues via Ethiopian music, kosmiche and hard rock in ‘At Giza’, placing Cisneros’ monotonic vox higher in the mix over shimmering backdrop of hazed hi-hats and uncurling bassline yoked with a tongue-tip tension.

But fret not heavy riff fiends, for that all comes with ‘Flight of the Eagle’, which effectively picks up where ‘Variation…’ left off, locking hard into a mantric cycle where Hakius’ damn slow but tight offbeat shuffles and the feedback worship riffs hold an intensity that breaks upward half way and soars in tumbling gyres to the end.
items._cn_summary: 这张2006年专辑是OM（Sleep成员Al Cisneros与Chris Hakius组合）的第二张作品，以冥想式慢速摇滚为核心。每面超过15分钟的时长体现了极简主义倾向，通过五声音阶、模态化和催眠式重复构建仪式化的空间感。创作明显受埃塞俄比亚音乐、宇宙摇滚（Popol Vuh、Earth）和布鲁斯硬摇滚影响，将传统stoner rock的粗粝感替换为更飘渺空灵的氛围。Cisneros的单调人声与Hakius的缓慢鼓击形成稳固的低频律动。本质上仍属迷幻/石人摇滚范畴，但其与民族音乐的跨界融合及强调恍惚状态的手法，与用户偏好的世界音乐和氛围类作品有所交集。总体来说，跨领域融合带来一定新意，但在实验性、电子声响和即兴层面相对有限，更接近传统迷幻摇滚的延伸而非前卫突破。

items.body:
Back after a four-year absence, Dublin's Gilla Band have lost none of their bite, packing two songs into 'Giraffe': one noisy, dubbed-out slow burner and a grotty, dance-punk coda.

It's hard to believe it's been so long since 'Most Normal', easily 2022's best "rock" album. And the Irish four piece tease the next album with 'Giraffe', a suitably absurd whirl of frontman Dara Kiely's observations and consternations that the rest of the crew meet with oblique rhythms, distortions and scratchy noise. If they can maintain this energy for the whole record, it's gonna be special.
items._cn_summary: Gilla Band（前身Girl Band）来自都柏林，这张《Giraffe》仅收录两首作品，属于post-punk与噪音摇滚范畴。首曲为dubbed-out风格的慢速噪音作品，次曲融入dance-punk元素，整体以扭曲失真、棱角分明的节奏和粗粝噪声为特征。乐队以非常规节奏编排、吉他音墙和即兴式噪音铺陈见长，呈现出后朋克传统中的实验性倾向。歌词内容围绕主唱Dara Kiely对日常事物的荒诞观察展开。该作品是乐队暌违四年的回归之作，为下一张全长专辑预热。音乐气质上与暗潮/后朋克领域有部分交集，dub与噪音摇滚的结合为其增添了一定实验色彩，但本质上仍以摇滚乐为根基，未深入到更广泛的电子或前卫领域。

items.body:
100% Silk veteran, Wisconsin’s Auscultation, does his raw but slinky, offbeat electro-house thing at a breezy mid-and-downtempo pace on the ever-charming label.

Their 4th bow on Amanda Brown’s sophisticate sub-division of NNF pursues a fine feel for dream house puckered with syncopated electro pulses and glazed in shine-eyed pads. It makes for warmest comparisons with vintage ’90s Rephlex of Bochum Welt in the iridescent whirl and parry of ‘Dysania’, and touches on Balihu-esque disco-house élan on ‘Mend’, while ‘Lusting’ slips of to Haruomi Hosono-like intricacies, and ‘Pinned’ drifts into dreamy dub. His strolling 8 min standout ’Severed Cord’ is primed for summer waft-offs, along with the effortless, feathered whirr of ‘Hazel Vacancy’.
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑出自威斯康星电子音乐人Auscultation，发行于独立小厂牌100% Silk旗下。整体风格为中低速的电子浩室，融合梦境浩室、迪斯科浩室与dub质感，编制中穿插不同步的电子脉冲和柔和的合成器pad。乐评将其与九十年代Rephlex厂牌旗下Bochum Welt的迷幻电子、Balihu的迪斯科浩室以及细野晴臣的精致编曲相类比，显示出一定的艺术取向与跨风格参照。歌曲如《Severed Cord》与《Hazel Vacancy》具有夏日氛围的漂浮感。作为独立厂牌发行的电子作品，其制作有一定实验边缘和复古致敬意味，但核心仍以浩室舞曲为骨架，与偏向IDM、ambient、glitch等更实验性电子风格存在距离。

items.body:
Label: Hammer Recordings, 2026

Personnel - Florian Arbenz: drums; Bill Frisell: guitar; Greg Osby: alto and soprano saxophone.

Swiss drummer and composer Florian Arbenz, known for his Conversation series, returns with Quiet Lights , featuring regular collaborator Greg Osby on saxophones and a new addition to his circle of musical associates: the remarkable Bill Frisell on guitar.

Boasting a deep Americana feel, “ Homenaje ” is layered with percussive dexterity, a coherent saxophone narrative, and a blend of bluesy and folksy guitar textures. Osby and Frisell drift in and out of the musical landscape before gradually bringing their lines into closer dialogue around the second minute. The trio becomes even more integrated as Frisell expands his chordal work, radiating beauty through his unmistakable tone. Osby responds with denser phrasing and a confident attack that heightens the tension, while the trio eventually plunges into a sleek, dance-like 12-beat rumba-inspired cycle. Also highlighting Arbenz’s affinity for Latin rhythms, “ Rhumba ” closes the album with a percussive pedal effect—emulating a bass line—and unexpected atmospheric gestures from Frisell, who subtly shapes the environment with electronics.

The mysterious “ Chant ” is initially underpinned by a sparse, dark-hued drone that, gradually allows light to seep in. Soft guitar textures are joined by shimmering cymbal colors and reflective soprano saxophone musings. The title track, “ Quiet Lights ”, carries a vibing quality and ambient pulse, weaving an elegant and refined texture. Arbenz employs custom-made percussion instruments alongside the drum kit, and the piece proves immediately accessible to the ear, much like “ Lueget vo Berg und Tal ”, a heartfelt reinterpretation of a traditional Swiss song reharmonized with cultivated taste.

On “ Jammin’ in the Children’s Corner ”, written by Arbenz for saxophonist Dave Liebman, the trio reveals especially compelling aspects of its chemistry. Here, rigorous preparation meets genuine spontaneity in an exhilarating journey marked by precise accentuation and a gravitational energy surrounding the alto saxophone lines over agile brushwork. Frisell’s punctuated observations emerge with sharp motivic instinct. “ The Barradas Opening ”, which alludes to Portuguese accordionist João Barradas, is a bluesy, groove-oriented slow burner distinguished by strong interplay and finely shaped unisons, bridging Americana and contemporary elements with ease.

Quiet Lights doesn’t really pack a punch, but unfolds gracefully without ever needing to force its impact, offering a charming and often introspective listening experience.

items._cn_summary: 这是一张由瑞士鼓手领衔的当代爵士三重奏专辑，融合了美式根源音乐、拉丁节奏与瑞士民谣元素。萨克斯与吉他的对话以旋律性和氛围感为主，编曲讲究克制与内省，偶有定制打击乐器和吉他电子效果增加音色层次。整体风格偏向优美、精致、易听的当代爵士，没有深入自由即兴或实验领域，电子元素也仅是点缀。跨文化融合（拉丁、瑞士传统民谣、现代爵士）为其增添了一定特色，但对偏好实验前卫、自由即兴和电子声响的听众而言，刺激度和冒险性明显不足。独立小厂牌发行，评论内容详实。

items.excerpt: GuldGanger - A review of the Danish trio's debut in RootsWorld
items.body: A debut, digital-only EP from a Danish trio, led by one of the Nordic folk scene’s outstanding and experienced vocalists, Mia Guldhammer. Five tracks, with the musicians bringing their own perspectives to mostly traditional music. There’s a lovely ancient, creaky mood throughout. The opener, “Svennedal,” with its rough, cantering rhythm, offers a perfect shop window for Guldhammer’s impressive, persuasive voice, while jaw harp and bagpipes bring an insistent propulsion to “Nordgård,” the only original here, by band member Morten Musicus. Cimbalom adds a delicate backdrop to the traditional “Agnete Of Bjergmanden,” with Guldhammer’s soft jaw harp offering extra textures to the other instruments, as it brings a springy opening to the final cut, “Ormsø,” mingling with flute and strings to create something quite thrilling and off kilter on this instrumental. Five tracks, and an introduction to a band that already seems very mature and accomplished. A strong beginning – what will GuldGanger do with an entire album?
items._cn_summary: 丹麦三人组合GuldGanger的首张数字EP，由北欧民谣界资深歌手Mia Guldhammer领衔。五首曲目以传统北欧民谣为基底，融入口簧琴、风笛、扬琴、长笛和弦乐等多样传统乐器，营造出古朴而略带怪异的氛围。乐手们各自带来不同的诠释视角，仅含一首由乐队成员Morten Musicus创作的原创曲。评论提到作品展现出'成熟而精湛'的气质，末曲以器乐形式呈现，被描述为'扣人心弦且失衡感十足'。整体定位偏向传统民谣框架内的艺术化处理，融合度尚可但实验性有限，适合对北欧民间音乐传统感兴趣的听众。

items.body:
Treble Puns, the Bangalore duo of Sohini Bhattacharya and Abhimanyu Roy, just released their new album 'Life Lessens 1: A God Named Frank'.

While their last release, 'Chill Ke Armaan', saw them take a break from their usual existential meanderings for irreverent humour, the latest record manages to do both over its 9 tracks of sombre jams, bookended by and alternating with comical skits that come underscored by sitcom-style music. They present a story of Frank, the junior God of honesty, who slept for millennia to wake up in the present times. At least, that is the device with which the band discusses things like the secret to happiness and satisfaction, vocally on 'Zen Commandments?' and then musically on 'Hey... Are You Happy?', or of the pressure to create content and market on social media instead of just being artists on the skit 'The Pursuit Of Crappiness', followed by 'Dog Eat Dog World'.

In times when through-listening of albums is on a decline in people's staple consumption habits to benefit concept albums, the skits on 'Life Lessens 1: A God Named Frank' slip into the ear more like a musical podcast (we are sure the characters on the skit will have something to say about this). The musical tracks, on the other hand, present some compositionally strong post-rock jams, limited mostly by the production value behind capturing the duo's energy on their respective instruments of drums and guitars that come supported with layers of synth.

Treble Puns even adds lyrical vocals to the fold for the first time. It works well when it joins the wall of sound that the band conjures, while the more unobscured verses on 'Hey... Are You Happy?' or 'Dog Eat Dog World' are clearly the limiters of the emotional profundity that the band creates with its guitar lines and drum replies. Away from such faultlines, 'Life Lessens 1: A God Named Frank' isn't just to be lauded as an interesting and ambitious album conceptually, but for being able to provide revisitable jams like 'Probably a Bad Idea' and the new directions signalled by the almost entirely electronically programmed 'Dog Eat Dog World'.

Listen to the album below and follow Treble Puns for more.

items._cn_summary: Treble Puns是一支来自印度班加罗尔的二人组合，本张专辑定位为概念唱片，以'诚实之神Frank'的叙事为线索，将后摇滚器乐段落与情景喜剧风格的间奏skit交替编排。音乐层面以鼓、吉他为核心，叠加合成器层次，末曲'Dog Eat Dog World'几乎完全采用电子编程制作，呈现出后摇滚与电子声响的融合倾向。专辑首次加入人声演唱，在融入器乐音墙时效果较好，但裸露的主歌段落被评价为削弱了情感深度。整体创作具有概念野心和一定的实验边缘性，但制作水准与声音探索的深度有限。

items._cn_summary: Ekmeles是一支以演绎当代新音乐为主的声乐合奏团，这张专辑《Nonsongs》由专注新音乐的小众厂牌New Focus发行。乐评将其表演水准比喻为顶级赛事中的裁判——当表演足够完美时，观众会忽略演奏者本身而聚焦于作品本身。评论指出Ekmeles的演绎超越了这种隐形状态，能在忠实呈现新作品的同时展现自身的艺术存在感。作为当代新音乐领域的合奏团体，其作品涉及现代作曲与实验性声乐创作，与用户关注的当代古典/现代作曲方向有一定契合度。然而，评论文本严重截断，无法获取关于具体音乐技法、配器特征或跨领域融合等详细信息，评估基于现有片段较为有限。

items._cn_summary: Revolting Cocks是与Al Jourgensen、Richard 23等工业音乐人相关的EBM/工业超级组合。本文内容为Peek-A-Boo杂志对其单曲《(Let's Get) Physical》视频片段的介绍，附有2017年比利时Retie及莱比锡Wave Gotik Treffen音乐节现场背景。该曲是对Olivia Newton-John八十年代流行金曲的工业风格翻唱，以EBM节奏和机械音色重新解构原曲的甜腻旋律，呈现出戏谑与颠覆并存的工业美学。作品风格契合暗潮/工业/EBM范畴，但本质为流行曲目的风格化翻唱，创新性有限。文章本身仅为视频片段展示而非原创乐评，歌词占据主要篇幅，缺乏深度评论文字，信息量较为有限。

items._cn_summary: Cocanha是一支以奥克西坦传统民谣为核心的音乐组合，作品扎根于法国南部奥克语区的民间音乐土壤，带有鲜明的世界音乐属性。从有限的乐评信息来看，该组合曾与Los Sara Fontán和Tarta Relena等艺术家合作，显示出一定的跨界融合意识。奥克语作为欧洲少数民族语言，为作品增添了独特的地域文化色彩。但乐评正文内容极为有限，无法充分判断其在编曲创新、声音设计或实验性方面的深度。该作品定位于世界音乐与欧洲传统民间音乐的交汇地带，对关注非主流文化视角的听众有一定吸引力。

items.body: Review by FrancescoProg — I'll say it right away to avoid misunderstandings: Prog is back!! And it comes once again from the North.The album is part of Jordsj�'s tenth anniversary celebrations. Initially conceived as a collection of unreleased tracks recorded in the studio between 2020 and 2025, the project then took on a life of its own, with the pieces intertwining thematically exploring themes such as war, chaos, the fall of rulers and the dawn of a new period, as well as cults and sects.The album was created, arranged and mixed entirely by the two founding members:H�kon Oftung (Multi-instrumentalist: guitars, flute, keyboards, vocals), leader of the group and leading figure in the psychedelic and progressive underground scene in Oslo. He has collaborated over time with cult bands such as Tusm�rke, The Chronicles of Father Robin, Wobbler and Zenon, just to name a few.Kristian Fr�land (Drums, percussion, production), childhood friend of Oftung and long-time partner in the Jordsj� project. In addition to taking care of the acoustic rhythm section, he personally took care of the production and mixing of Pestkr�nikene, giving the album its peculiar 70s analog sound.Prominent artists have been invited to contribute significantly to specific tracks.Jon A. Henriksen, multi-instrumentalist and singer, lends his voice to the songs "White Magic" and "Talisman II". He is the creator of Black Magic, a Norwegian band that started as a heavy/doom/black metal project and then veered towards 70s hard rock sounds. He collaborated with H�kon Oftung for many years in Black Magic.Kristian Valbo, well-known extreme metal drummer of the historic Norwegian bands Obliteration and Aura Noir, takes care of the drums, rototoms and artwork of the song "Spiritual Lament". For this album he demonstrated his crossover versatility by playing percussion and doing the cover art.Lars Fredrik Fr�islie, keyboardist and mastermind of Wobbler, one of the leading bands of modern symphonic prog, performs a MiniMoog synthesizer solo on the track "Kaosveldets Endelikt". He is a great fan and collector of vintage keyboards (Mellotron, Hammond, Moog), with which he recreates atmospheres faithful to the early 70s.Andreas Prestmo, lead singer and lyricist of The Wobbler, as well as frontman of The Chronicles of Father Robin, is the guest vocalist on the song "The Awakened". He is famous in the Scandinavian scene for his evocative and theatrical vocal lines, ideal for the mythological lyrics of Jordsj�.The title "Pestkr�nikene" means "The Plague Chronicles" in Norwegian. This title embodies the central idea of the album: a dark and mythological concept album that revolves around destruction, distorted faith and the rebirth that follows. The songs on the album are connected by a coherent theme and lyrics, based on four fundamental elements: war and destruction, the collapse of old social structures; the fall of kings, the brutal end of kingdoms, monarchs and empires; sects and cults, religious and spiritual fanaticism in times of crisis; It is the dawn of a new era, the birth of a new period from the ruins of devastation.In this apocalyptic context, the band blends its hard rock and heavy metal roots with folk and psychedelic elements, creating a real "sound alchemy" to tell the eternal cycle of death and rebirth.The album alternates sung songs with entirely instrumental compositions, in perfect Scandinavian progressive rock style. The vocal tracks are "Pestkr�nikene" (in Norwegian), "White Magic", "Seven Heads", "The Awakened", "Spiritual Lament" and "Talisman II" (all in English). Instead, "Kaosvelde" and "Kaosveldets Endelikt" are completely instrumental.I particularly appreciate the use of the Norwegian language in their songs since always, which makes them archaic, solemn, mystical and profound. On this album, the English-language songs are no different, they manage to evoke the same feeling thanks to the splendid interpretations.This album was made with an artisanal and vintage approach, far from modern and digital productions. The sound is rich and warm, created with iconic analog keyboards such as the MiniMoog and the Mellotron that weaves orchestral sound carpets. The Hammond organ and piano, then, drive the main melodies with timeless class. The hard rock energy is perfectly balanced by dreamy and acoustic sections, creating an immersive and dynamic atmosphere.The flute, played by H�kon Oftung, remains one of the band's hallmarks, intertwining with guitars and recalling the greats of progressive rock. Despite the complex structures and the continuous changes of tempo, the structured suites and the symphonic atmospheres typical of northern European prog (inspired by Scandinavian bands such as Landberk, �nglag�rd and the Wobbler themselves), the album is compact, with a total duration of only 36 minutes, a real concentrate of energy and creativity."Pestkr�nikene", a song sung in Norwegian, opens the album with an immediate immersion in the band's new 70s hard rock sound. Powerful guitar riffs alternate with soothing flute sections, creating an atmosphere that oscillates between tension and relaxation. The song explores the theme of cyclical time, with the "plague" representing the social and moral collapse that is repeated every time humanity forgets history and breaks the balance. H�kon Oftung deftly juggles sharp guitars and a dreamlike flute, while Kristian Fr�land's rhythm section adds a touch of vintage analogue warmth. The main riff, inspired by classic hard/prog, is simply splendid."White Magic", a song sung in English, is one of the catchiest songs on the album, its hypnotic and decidedly psychedelic rhythm, combined with folk influences, creates an atmospheric rock that immediately enters the head while maintaining a complex structure. The song describes the dynamics of psychological manipulation within cults, with the "White Magic Man" seducing the minds of his fifty followers with utopian promises that work like a drug ("poppy seeds"). Jon A. Henriksen, with his theatrical and charismatic voice, perfectly interprets the ambiguity of the cult leader. The song has an extremely engaging chorus. The countermelodies are beautiful and the mood is both positive and expresses an atmosphere of urgency. When the song slows down there is a great guitar solo with exceptional sustain. Great song."Seven Heads", a song sung in English, enhances the darker and heavier side of the band, touching primitive doom rock but resulting in sudden symphonic melodic moments dominated by the Mellotron. The apocalyptic symbolism is evident: the "Seven Heads" refer to the biblical Beast and symbolize the destructive arrogance of declining political and religious power. Oftung's work on vintage keyboards (Hammond organ and Mellotron) creates a majestic wall of sound that emphasizes the sense of impending catastrophe. The backbone groove of the excellent rhythm section is composed of multiple inlays and chisellings. The alternation of flute and guitar when the atmosphere becomes tense is splendid. The central tempo change, which transports the piece into a spooky atmosphere is absolutely great. Great vocal interpretation at the end of the song, when he returns to the hard rhythm, of an extraordinary rock. Textbook closure. Beautiful piece."Kaosvelde - Vasallens Elegi" is the first fully instrumental track on the album, a jewel of progressive folk, with acoustic guitars and flute that intertwine in an elegant way, evoking a woody and melancholic atmosphere reminiscent of the Scandinavian tradition of the early 70s. It is the lament of a vassal who helplessly witnesses the chaos that invades his kingdom, marking the end of the old feudal order. Oftung's acoustic performance is impeccable, and Fr�land's minimal and evocative percussion marks an almost solemn tempo, in a slow and continuous credendo that briefly seems to accelerate but then returns imposing and solemn. The central flute solo is poignant and dreamlike, and adds a touch of melancholy to the narrative."Kaosveldets Endelikt", a completely instrumental track, is the sequel to the previous track to which it is inextricably fused, but this time in an electric and majestic key. The style shifts towards a more complex symphonic prog and a fast tempo with Heavy Metal accents, describing the final act of the collapse of the kings. Primordial chaos takes over, wiping out corrupt hierarchies. Lars Fredrik Fr�islie's intervention is extraordinary, with a virtuoso MiniMoog analog synthesizer solo cutting through the track like lightning, an exceptional solo explosion. Great energy and transport not without clich�s typical of the genre and of fine workmanship. The guitars are often doubled and the drums are metronomic with thrilling rolls. Great piece,"The Awakened", a song sung in English, is a theatrical, dynamic and dramatic song. The sound combines structural complexity with airy and solemn vocal melodies typical of Nordic symphonic rock. The focus shifts to the survivors, forced to walk through the rubble with a new, painful spiritual self-awareness after the catastrophe. The guest voice of Andreas Prestmo is the fulcrum of the piece; its timbre gives an epic and poignant tone to the narrative. The mood and voice are very prog, the excellent guitar riff alternates in a game of back and forth with the keyboards. The intertwining of Prestmo's vocal lines and Mellotron's carpets is splendid, creating an evocative and engaging atmosphere. Monstrous bass throughout the song, sharp guitar."Spiritual Lament", a song sung in English, is a deep and reflective track, with a ritual atmosphere. The tones become more intense and decidedly rock, abandoning the lightness of folk to embrace a psychedelic sound full of emotions. The beginning is very King Crimson. It represents an inner journey of grieving and searching for peace, symbolizing the spiritual emptiness that a person can feel when his old material certainties are lost. Kristian Valbo on drums introduces the rototoms, giving a powerful and tribal rhythm. The song is animated by an amazing bass line with which the guitar dialogues wonderfully. Rich and powerful battery. The splendid voice of a beautiful vocal enters about halfway through the song after a long instrumental section and the song becomes more folk, before resuming the initial mood that with the voice becomes epic and imposing. Towards the end the atmosphere becomes decidedly psychedelic and is the basis for a stratospheric guitar solo. The closing was beautiful. Great drums that stand out in this beautiful piece."Talisman II", a song sung in English, is the perfect conclusion to the album. An epic track that mixes hard rock with the tempo changes typical of symphonic prog, culminating in an emotional finale that leaves a sense of completeness. The talisman, a magical and symbolic object guardian of knowledge, is essential to overcome difficult times and start a new era of rebirth. Jon A. Henriksen returns to vocals to support Oftung, closing the conceptual circle of the album. The final interaction between electric guitar, synthesizers and drums is magnificent, and the final instrumental coda is liberating and beautifully arranged. There is a folk mood that never disappears. The entries overlap and complement each other. A song of extraordinary structure and power, powerful even in the most folk phase, it explodes in the epic phases. The singing and the piece as a whole are extraordinary.Pestkr�nikene is an album that is like a journey through time through a mix of musical genres performed with great skill and blended together in a brilliant way, a sound experience that blends hard rock and classic heavy metal of the 70s with typical atmospheres of progressive rock, folk and psychedelic, without losing contact with the Scandinavian tradition. Compared to Jordsj�'s previous pastoral and acoustic works, this album stands out for a more powerful and decisive sound, a real tribute to the heaviest hard rock scene of those years. The voices and performances of the individual musicians are splendid, a screaming rhythm section.Essential album, so far the best of 2026. Prog is back!!
items._cn_summary: 挪威乐队Jordsjø的第十周年纪念专辑《Pestkrønikene》（瘟疫编年史），属于交响前卫摇滚（Symphonic Prog）范畴。专辑以七十年代模拟音色为核心，融合Mellotron、Hammond、Moog等复古键盘，邀请多位挪威地下音乐人参与客串。主题围绕战争、毁灭、信仰扭曲与重生展开，呈现概念专辑式的叙事结构，歌词充满神话与末世色彩。音乐风格偏向传统交响前卫，对七十年代经典语汇的忠实复刻较为保守，在声音探索与实验性层面着墨有限，与先锋派、实验前卫的取向存在明显距离。整体定位是面向复古前卫爱好者的怀旧之作，而非突破性的声音实验。

items.body: Spanish synthpop and futurepop act Culture Kultür release their new album “Atomic” tomorrow, June 6, 2026, through Caustic Records, with a launch concert on the same date in Madrid. The Culture Kultür “Atomic” album is the group’s first full-length since “Humanity” in 2019. Tickets are sold online right here and in physical outlets Rara Avis and Escridiscos. The album was preceded by the single “Atomic Radio”, which we covered when it appeared in March 2026. Caustic Records also issued the band’s “Time” on vinyl in 2025. About Culture Kultür Culture Kultür is a synthpop and electronic project from Málaga, Spain, formed in 1992 around José Luis Clotet, who performs under the name Josua. Singer Salva Maine joined in 1999 and has fronted the band’s recordings since. The live line-up has included Distortiongirl on keyboards. The group’s studio discography includes “Reflex” (1999), “Revenge” (2001), “Reborn” (2005, Out Of Line), “Spirit” (2010, Caustic Records) and “Humanity” (2019, Caustic Records). The band’s catalogue moves between synthpop, futurepop and darker electronics, and it has been signed to Caustic Records for the recent years. “Atomic” is the band’s latest album, released on June 6, 2026, alongside the launch concert in Madrid.
items._cn_summary: 西班牙合成器流行与未来流行乐队Culture Kultür于2026年6月6日通过独立厂牌Caustic Records发行新专辑《Atomic》，并在马德里举办发布演出。乐队1992年成立于马拉加，主创为José Luis Clotet（艺名Josua），1999年起由主唱Salva Maine主导录音工作。乐队风格游走于合成器流行、未来流行与更黑暗的电子音乐之间，曾在Out of Line与Caustic Records等EBM/暗潮系厂牌发表作品。《Atomic》是乐队继2019年《Humanity》之后的首张全长专辑，此前已释出先行单曲《Atomic Radio》。本文为新闻通稿性质，内容以发行信息与乐队历史介绍为主，缺乏对音乐本体、声响设计及创作手法的深入评析。

items.body:
Low-key cult Japanese house entity Shin Watanabe trades in pure, redlit deep house sleaze on a substantial debut payload for L.I.E.S.

‘Red Zone-Ethos Mama Trax’ arrives in the wake of Watanabe’s introductory ‘Album 1986’ (Hot Street Records, 2025) with a sureshot affirmation of his greazy steez up-to-the-hilt on 13 ‘floor-ready jams. The spectres of earliest Chi and NYC house are summoned with strong attention to the sound’s subtle variegation and fine grasp of its raw but classy hallmarks, or more simply what makes it endure in the dance floor’s collective imagination.

Tune to tune he pinpoints the sound coming into its own from a blend of prevailing disco, industrial, soul and synth-pop touchstones, and with particular emphasis on its sinuous, psychosexual thirst/thrust. Shake  stick and you’ll hit an ace anywhere across the set, from the haughty stride and belting vox of pt. VI thru the sexy Lynchian chords of pt. III, to DJ Pierre-esque percolations in pt. I, a Burrell Brothers-like pt. II, the body-floatigb warehouse sassy of pt. VII, and Virgo Fpur styles on pt. X.
items._cn_summary: 日本制作人Shin Watanabe在独立厂牌L.I.E.S.发行的首张专辑，以十三首深浩室舞曲呈现。整体风格根植于早期芝加哥与纽约浩室传统，融合迪斯科、工业、灵魂乐与合成器流行元素，质感偏向暗沉、感性、带有放克式的律动。部分曲目被描述为'林奇式'和弦与仓库式的粗粝氛围，与暗潮及工业音乐存在一定的美学交集。然而，作品整体运作在浩室舞曲的既定范式之内，并非以实验性或前卫性为诉求，音色设计与节奏编排均较为传统，更偏重舞池功能性而非声音艺术的探索。对于关注实验电子、IDM、氛围及暗潮领域的听众而言，此专辑的契合度有限。

items.body:
London’s soul positive festival-turned-family, GALA hail a decade of community action with 15 cuts spanning Charlie Dark’s spoken word to Marcellus Pittman’s choice deep house, soca-techno from Amaliah, and Yu Su’s dreamy garage-house glyder...

"Ten Years of GALA is both an archive and a horizon: a reflection on where GALA has come from, and a signal of what lies ahead. Founded in 2016 as a one-day gathering in South London, GALA has grown into a global point of reference for dancers, artists and collectives drawn together by a shared commitment to independence, collaboration and underground music culture. Rather than charting success through scale alone, the festival has consistently prioritised integrity, community and musical curiosity – values that underpin this release.

Spanning fifteen tracks, Ten Years of GALA unfolds as a considered journey. It opens with an intimate spoken contribution from Charlie Dark, grounding the compilation firmly in GALA’s home of Peckham before gradually expanding outward into fuller, club-focused terrain. From there, the record moves between moods and tempos, tracing a path from reflective moments into the physical language of the dancefloor.

The compilation brings together longtime friends of the festival alongside newer voices drawn into its orbit in recent years. Each artist contributes a distinct perspective, but collectively the tracks form a coherent portrait – not of a single sound, but of a shared ethos shaped over ten years of gatherings, collaborations and days spent dancing together.

Rather than a retrospective in the conventional sense, Ten Years of GALA functions as a living document. It captures fragments of past editions, scenes and relationships, while remaining firmly oriented toward the future. These are not museum pieces, but records designed to be played, shared and folded back into the spaces from which they came. Together, the compilation holds a piece of GALA’s first decade – not as a closed chapter, but as a foundation for what comes next."
items._cn_summary: GALA伦敦地下音乐节十周年合辑，收录十五首作品，涵盖口头诗（Charlie Dark）、深沉浩室（Marcellus Pittman）、soca-techno（Amaliah）及梦幻车库浩室（Yu Su）等风格。合辑以Peckham为起点，由内敛逐渐展开至俱乐部舞池语境，在反思与律动之间形成连贯脉络。整体定位为地下社群文化档案，强调独立性、协作精神与音乐探索，而非传统回顾性精选。音乐风格偏向舞曲方向的电子制作，跨域融合体现在口语、soca节奏与浩室结构的交织上，但整体声响设计趋向常规俱乐部语境，实验性与前卫色彩有限。

items.body:
YOUTH return with a second dose of inexorable House pressure from Paul Bennett aka Duster Valentine, primed for DJs and dancers and a sureshot tip FFO Michael J. Blood, Todd Terry, Ron Trent, Anthony “Shake” Shakir, DJ Sprinkles…

Aye it’s another haul of hard hitting gems pressed to vinyl for the first time, a love note to formative years in the ‘80s and early ‘90s, off his chops at The Haçienda and other legendary Manchester spots. It’s a masterclass in demonstrating the flavours-within-a-theme that emerged from the Chi, 313, and NYC during that pivotal era, and which would eventually light the touch paper of a UK club revolution. 

In Duster Valentine’s hands, the sound is presented stripped to salient fundamentals, before it went commercial, ranging from sampler-knuckling garage-house stabbers thru haughty canter and plushest, pendulous grooves. He homes in hard on the exact point when hip hop and electro gave way to house in the Todd Terry-via-Pal Joey style jam ‘Getting’ Dub’, and gives a big salute to Chez N Trent’s rugged, chord-riding haughtiness via Levon Vincent in ‘Hit Me From Behind’.

‘Strobelight Honnies’ leans into the sound’s deepest ends with a perfectly weighted bassline, cold drums and sublime string tension dubbed with hypnotic elegance, where ‘The KatG Chord’ follows with shimmers of Anthony Shakir via Michael J Blood. Suffice it to say they’re all essential and bang on the dollar if you know what’s good.

100% perlers!
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑由英国制作人Duster Valentine（Paul Bennett）发行于独立厂牌YOUTH，是向八十年代末至九十年代初芝加哥、底特律与纽约经典House音乐致敬的复古风格作品。乐评将其定位为硬朗的地下House与Garage House，风格涵盖采样驱动的stab段落、沉重低音线与dub式弦乐张力，制作回归House成型期的简约美学。参考艺人包括Todd Terry、Ron Trent、Anthony Shakir、DJ Sprinkles等，均为该领域代表人物。整体属于流派回溯与重制性质的唱片，强调经典律动与俱乐部实用性，偏向传统House谱系内的扎实呈现，但在声音探索与实验层面较为有限，与用户偏好的IDM、Glitch、Ambient等前卫电子方向距离较远。

items.body:
After curating beloved annual edits comps for years, Latane Hughes and Billy Scher are now making their own music with the help of producer Miles Felix.

"Look, there are a lot of DJ duos in Brooklyn. Most of them are fine. Fundido are the kind who’ve been doing the good work for 10 years. What started as euphoric, after-band free-for-alls in the front room at Baby’s All Right now takes place in increasingly bigger rooms, further afield, regulars and new faces side by side. It’s a music lover’s paradise and a responsible adult’s worst nightmare.

“Get A Grip” felt almost purpose-built for DFA: four-on-the-floor drums, a synth that maws away your inhibitions, a vocal from Emma Dufaux that closes the deal. It’s really good.

The 12” gives you four ways to hear it: the Original Mix, a Bliss Mix (less maw), and remixes from rising stars Make A Dance and Asa Tate. These guys spent a decade learning what makes people lose themselves and keep coming back. Now they’re making the tracks to match."
items._cn_summary: Fundido是来自布鲁克林的DJ双人组，携手制作人Miles Felix和歌手Emma Dufaux推出的舞曲单曲。音乐风格以四四拍舞曲节奏为核心，合成器音色浓郁，搭配人声演唱，整体定位偏向DFA厂牌美学的俱乐部舞曲。该作品以12寸黑胶形式发行，包含原版混音、Bliss混音及两组remix版本。乐评指出他们经过十年DJ生涯积累了对舞池氛围的把握能力，如今开始制作匹配自身审美的舞曲作品。从风格定位看，这属于主流俱乐部舞曲范畴，强调功能性舞蹈体验，与实验电子、IDM、氛围及暗潮等更具探索性的电子音乐路线存在明显距离。

items.body:
A strong breeze of Cajun twang from 1920’s Louisiana, delivered by the excellent Death Is Not The End 

Taking its title from the first in a series of Cajun recordings made in New Orleans and released by Columbia Records, namely the Segura Brothers’ Bury Me In The Corner Of The Yard, the rest of the set follows suit with infectious stompers, rattlers and wheezers about whiskey-running, unrequited love and turtle stew, by excellent names such as Artelus Mistric and Blind Uncle Gaspard, all with equally charming tunes to boot.
items._cn_summary: 这是一张由地下厂牌Death Is Not The End整理发行的1920年代路易斯安那州卡津音乐合集，收录了Segura Brothers、Artelus Mistric、Blind Uncle Gaspard等艺人的早期录音。音乐内容围绕威士忌走私、单相思和龟肉汤等生活主题，呈现典型的卡津传统民间风格，包含手风琴、提琴等原声乐器的粗犷演奏。该合集具有一定的地域文化特色，作为美国南部阿卡迪亚移民音乐传统的档案性整理具有文献价值。然而，从用户偏好来看，这是纯粹的传统民间音乐，缺乏实验性、前卫元素或跨类型融合，与用户关注的实验音乐、自由爵士、电子声响及暗潮等方向距离较远，更接近纯民间类目，与世界融合音乐也有所区别。

items.body:
Wino finally drop the long-teased label debut of Dublin pal Officer John, operating with a sort of dusted trip hop energy that starts off full of baggy swagger and gets more blissed as we go, finishing off with a remix from long serving label captain Morgan Buckley. 

Wino cap off an imperial 2025 with a 6 track peach from Niall Rogers aka Officer John, opening with sleeper hit ‘Stay’ that comes like The Beta Band riffing on MBV’s ‘soon’, before ‘Pass’ takes us to a more downbeat landscape just north of A.S.O., while ‘Handle’ feels like a late summer afternoon soundtracked by some Escho ace. To end, Morgan Buckley ups the funky drummer and stutters the vox for a classic slice of 90’s balearic-pop.

It’s all so naggingly ear-wormy and achingly familiar that it already feels like a classic. Sleep and, um, weep?!
items._cn_summary: 这张由都柏林音乐人Officer John（Niall Rogers）制作的六曲专辑在独立厂牌Wino发行，定位为带有90年代Trip Hop与Balearic流行气质的电子作品。评论将其风格参照系定位于The Beta Band对MBV式的吉他音色处理、A.S.O.式的downbeat氛围以及90年代Balearic-pop的律动，整体偏向慵懒、迷幻、悦耳易记的方向，并附有厂牌主理人Morgan Buckley的混音作品。音乐语言以合成器、采样鼓机与失真人声为主，制作精良但风格上更贴近舒适怀旧的电子流行范畴，与实验前卫、自由即兴或IDM等取向存在一定距离。整体听感熟悉亲切，但缺乏突出的创新性与实验性。

items.body: Live at Rockpalast 1999 documents a command performance at the Loreley open-air amphitheater by Malcolm “Mac” Rebennack Jr., aka Dr. John. Rockpalast is a live-music TV show broadcast since 1974 by Westdeutscher Rundfunk (WDR), the archival source for this CD-DVD package, and coincidentally a remarkable cultural institution on its own terms. Taped at the height of Dr. John’s international popularity, backing the singer-pianist-guitarist are New Orleans stalwarts Bobby Broom (guitar), David Barard (bass), and Herman Ernest (drums), a tight quartet that projects authority and engages the crowd from start to close. A striking UNESCO-designated World Heritage Site set, the Loreley is a slate pinnacle on a mythic horseshoe bend of the Rhine River, memorializing an enduring German literary legend both tragic and romantic. The setting is thus well-suited for Mac’s mystical spirit and lyrical style. By this stage of his career, he characterized his live show as a Mardi Gras revue with a mix of New Orleans standards and some of his most recognizable compositions. Hence, he opens with the NOLA classic “Iko, Iko,” a half-sung, half-chanted celebration of community participation in the renowned Mardi Gras second-line street procession. Then comes the in-your-face boast “Qualified,” wherein the singer warns, “I got the power to control / I can see clean through you, blind mole / I want to tell you now, I'm qualified / You know that I'm qualified.” Any Dr. John fan will recognize “I Walk on Guilded Splinters,” a moody, percussively insistent, foreboding expression of the Night Tripper’s immersion in “funknology” (his term), gris-gris herbology, and hoodoo incantation, punctuated with jungle growls and cries, a loopy, spooky slide whistle, and an extended psych-guitar solo: “Walk thru the fire / Fly thru the smoke / See my enemy / At the end of dey rope.” Every piece in this well- honed set deserves considertion. Although Dr John lived for many years in Los Angeles and New York, his enduring hometown connection shows in the fond inclusion of his own “Sweet Home New Orleans” and “Goin’ Back to New Orleans,” and he nods to a key influence with a funky rendering of Duke Ellington’s “I'm Gonna Go Fishin’.” Among other gems are Mac’s Top–10 hit “Right Place, Wrong Time,” and the instantly recognizable closer, Earl King’s “Big Chief,” another Mardi Gras burner. Regarding his live performance approach, per the notes, “I always play a little bit of everything. I think that’s what music’s about: a little bit of somethin’ old, somethin’ in the middle, somethin’ new, and somethin’ as yet uncreated.” Dr John's’s longtime fans will welcome this archival gem, which also is a solid introduction for any late comers to the party. Surmounting the barriers of language and culture, the power of At the Rockpalast is also evident in the enthusiastic audience response. As he declares, “If you’re gonna get off on somethin’ you don’t need to know nothin’ about it. Music is a universal language.”
items._cn_summary: 这张现场专辑记录了Dr. John在德国洛雷莱露天剧场的演出，乐队由新奥尔良资深乐手组成，风格以传统R&B、布鲁斯、放克和新奥尔良Mardi Gras音乐为核心。演出中融入伏都教神秘主义元素、丛林咆哮与迷幻吉他独奏，呈现出'funknology'式的怪诞氛围。曲目涵盖'Iko Iko'、'I Walk on Guilded Splinters'等经典，展现了浓厚的地域文化色彩。然而，从风格定位来看，这仍属于美国根源音乐的范畴，虽然带有一定的迷幻与异域元素，但与用户偏好的实验前卫、自由爵士、电子乐及暗潮等方向存在明显距离。整体制作扎实，演出充满现场感染力，但对追求实验性与先锋声响的听众而言，创新程度有限。

items.excerpt: Les Crimes du Musette by Dominique Cravic et les Primitifs du futur
items.body: Sometime in 1986, perhaps in a Paris café, Dominique Cravic, a singer, guitarist, and musical archivist, met Robert Crumb, an underground cartoonist, banjo and mandolin player, and jug-band aficionado. Over a few glasses of marc, to continue to speculate, they conjured up the idea for Les Primitifs du futur. Since then, they have recorded an impossible-to-categorize series of albums, with cover illustrations by Crumb, of which Les Crimes du Mussette is the fifth. Weird and wonderful, it sounds like they rooted through an attic full of 78 RPM records, scribbled down some arrangements, and then played them on a collection of instruments they found in another attic, including accordion, sax, xylophone, clarinet, banjo, ukulele, theremin, Hawaiian guitar, bagpipe chanter (I’m guessing here), and musical saw. Ne tirez pas sur le pianiste (excerpt) The 27 short tracks are mostly voiced by Cravic, who talk-sings in the manner of an everyman Maurice Chevalier. He is often accompanied by the accordion, a customary instrument in the bal-musette style that remains a strong element of the eclectic range of styles they have managed to synthesize. They also include ragtime, jug, French chanson, and, to my ears, skiffle, just to get the list started. Ukulele Lady (excerpt) The liner notes point out that “Les Crimes du Musette is also a gold mine for scholars, a veritable treasure trove.” Exploring the treasures is beyond my scope here, as each tune has a long history. A highlight for me is the humorous “Ukulele Lady” from 1925, which first delighted me on Arlo Guthrie’s 1971 album Hobo’s Lullaby . The song has also been covered by Bing Crosby, Peter Sellers, and Bette Midler. N'oublie pas Gréco (excerpt) A more serious item is “N’oublie pas Gréco” (Don’t Forget Gréco”) is a tribute to the legendary chanteuse and heroine of the French Resistance, Juliette Gréco, who died in 2020. You will also hear old chestnuts like “Fumée aux yeux” (“Smoke Gets in Your Eyes”), “Boude pas” (“Take Five”), and “Prive d’amour” (“As Time Goes By”). This record is a curiosity, but it is performed by serious musicians with total commitment. In this, I was reminded of the similarly indefinable Dan Hicks & the Hot Licks. Long-forgotten music and abandoned styles are given new animation with obvious enthusiasm and care. Speaking about himself and his collaborators, many of whom are in their seventies, Dominique Cravic says, “The young have fire, but we have light.” In its own little corner, Les Crimes du Musette shines bright.
items._cn_summary: 《Les Crimes du Musette》是法国组合Les Primitifs du futur的第五张专辑，由歌手兼吉他手Dominique Cravic与地下漫画家Robert Crumb合作完成，融合了法国bal-musette、拉格泰姆、罐乐队音乐、法国香颂、skiffle等多种20世纪上半叶流行音乐风格。专辑收录27首短曲，使用手风琴、萨克斯、木琴、单簧管、班卓琴、尤克里里、特雷门琴、夏威夷吉他、风笛及音乐锯等非常规乐器录制。Cravic以近似Maurice Chevalier的念唱方式演绎多首经典老歌，包括向已故法国抵抗运动女歌手Juliette Gréco致敬的曲目。整体定位为复古风格的民间音乐档案式整理与再现，由资深音乐人以严肃态度演绎多国传统流行曲调，展现出对被遗忘音乐的重新激活。

items.excerpt: Estudiantina of Melbourne – Ta Nisia [The Islands] (self-release, 2026) Estudiantina Of Melbourne presents its second album, Ta Nisia (The Islands), an independently-released recording. The…
items.body:
Estudiantina of Melbourne – Ta Nisia [The Islands] (self-release, 2026)

Estudiantina Of Melbourne presents its second album, Ta Nisia (The Islands), an independently-released recording. The new work follows the ensemble’s debut, Journey to Rebetika, and arrives after two years of activity that included 26 concerts.

The new album reflects both continuity and change. The group’s music remains rooted in captivating smyrneika and rebetiko, taking the listener on a tour of joyful Greek taverns and nightclubs. At the same time, Ta Nisia also points to a broader musical direction. In turn, the title carries both a literal and symbolic meaning: each track stands on its own. Nevertheless, together, the pieces trace a larger story of migration, identity, growth, and belonging.

The lineup on the album features regular ensemble members Maria Antaras-Dalamagas on accordion and vocals; Vagelis Ginis on vocals; Camille El Feghali on kanun; Jenny Dixon on violin; Alex Petropoulos on guitar; Paul Karalis on bouzouki; Con Kalamaras on bouzouki and vocals; and Rosco Heck on percussion. Guest musicians Indra Buraczewska on double bass and Tim Meyen on cimbalom also appear on the release. Meyen’s instrument, a 145-string Austro-Hungarian cimbalom, adds an unusual, charming tonal element to the ensemble’s established sound.

At the same time, Ta Nisia reflects the cultural mix of Melbourne, where the group formed and developed its identity.

Musicians: Alex Petropoulos on guitar, vocals, lavta; Camille El Feghali on kanun, zurna; Con Kalamaras on bouzouki, vocals, lavta; Jenny Dixon on violin; Maria AntarasonDalamagas on accordion, vocals; Paul Karalis on bouzouki, oud; Rosco Heck on percussion; Vagellis Ginis on vocals. Guest musicians: Indra Buraczewska on bass; and Tim Meyen on cimbalom.

Kieran McCoey, recording engineer. Recorded at 3MBS Studios Abbotsford Convent Melbourne 2025
Album artwork by Matthew Revert.

items.body: Review by andrea — " Pangea e le tre lune" is the fourth album by Il Cerchio d'Oro and was released in 2023 on the independent Black Widow Records label with a line up featuring Franco Piccolini (keyboards), Giuseppe Terribile (bass, vocals), Gino Terribile (drums, percussion, vocals), Piuccio Pradal (guitar, vocals) and Massimo Spica (guitar) plus some prestigious guests such as Donald Lax (violin, from historic Italianprog band Quella Vecchia Locanda), Tolo Marton (guitar, former member of Le Orme), Ricky Belloni (guitar, from Nuova Idea and New Trolls), Valerio Piccioli (guitar) and Carlo Deprati (narrative vocals) who contributed to enrich the sound. This album confirms all the good qualities of the band's previous works, with a sound deeply rooted in the seventies yet never overly nostalgic and a music always in service of the storyline. It's a concept alnum that tells of the birth of the Earth with fantasy and fairytale nuances. The lyrics are by Giuseppe Paolino, an old friend of the band, while the beautiful art cover is by Armando Mancini, a talented painter who's behind some seventies iconic prog album covers like those of Quella Vecchia Locanda...The title of the opener, "Pangea", refers to the supercontinent that existed during the late Paleozoic and early Mesozoic eras and began to break apart about 200 million years ago. After a dreamlike introduction with piano and flute in the foreground, the music and lyrics evoke a ball of fire that some god has carelessly hurdled into eternity. The music is dense and rich with shifts in tempo and atmosphere, while the lyrics, with nuanced tones, outline the mystery of creation. No one knows exactly how it happened, there are no witnesses, but the flame slowly turned into Earth. So, it's just a strange trick of fate that gave life, almost with childlike innocence, to this new entity that will become a continent and be called Pangea...In "Alla deriva" (Adrift) the music and lyrics describe the new continent floating on dark, restless waters, a lifeless land slowly drifting aimlessly across a frightening landscape. Three amused moons watch over it from the sky...Introduced by a dreamlike section with the violin in the forefront, "Dialogo" (Dialogue) evokes the image of a shooting star causing the fragmentation of the new continent. The fractured land turns to the wind and the moon, giving rise to an imaginary dialogue. The wind pushes Pangea onto the sea waves and lifts it to seek a new path, while a friendly moon watches from above and smiles, accompanying it into the darkness of the night..."Le tre lune" (The three moons) is a complex piece, rich in nuances and changes in rhythm and atmosphere. The music and lyrics evoke the image of three moons slowly revolving around the Earth. The first is red, the second yellow, and the third is black, blending into the darkness of the night. Each moon chases the other, casting colourful reflections on the sea of ​​Pangea. These marvellous reflections spark a dispute between the three vain moons. Eventually, the yellow and red moons implode and dissolve, leaving only the black moon in the sky of Pangea. Over time, the black moon learns to wear yellow and red colurs, while it tires of black and, from then on, wears it, albeit elegantly, only occasionally...The instrumental introduction to "Dal nulla cos�" (Out of nowhere, like that) might recall Le Orme, but the piece then develops in an original way. The music and lyrics describe a desolate and hostile landscape: a dark sea, brown earth, earthquakes and storms, winds and active volcanoes. Who would have thought that life could arise in such a place? Yet there was no past nor fear, and life began its journey toward an unknown future,...The next piece, "E la vita inizi�" (And life began), dreamily describes the beginning of life on Earth. Beneath a carpet of stars, Pangea continued its journey unstoppably, driven by a rebellious sea. The continent broke apart, then reunited, changing shape several times until reaching its current form. Chance, chemistry, and the sun's rays helped life emerge from the seabed, now less dark and threatening. An evolutionary process destined to never stop...The album's final piece, "Crisi" (Crises), is listed as a bonus track and has nothing to do with the concept. It's a hard rock song (with obvious references to Deep Purple) released as a single in 1981 and occasionally played by the band during their concerts. It deals with the economic crisis and social values ​​of the late 1970s...On the whole, an excellent work that should find a place in your Italianprog collection!

items.body: The Portland, Oregon-based synth-punk duo Point Line Plane has released its self-titled debut album, “Point Line Plane,” on SKiN GRAFT Records. The release marks the first-ever vinyl pressing of the record, which was originally co-released on CD by Xeroid Records and Sincere Brutality in 2003 and has been out of print for more than twenty years. Formats include LP, CD, digital and an Ultimate Edition. The vinyl edition is pressed on 8-Bit Blue Vinyl, limited to 1500 numbered copies worldwide. Packaging includes a double-sided “Footlong” OBI with artwork by Portland designer E*Rock. A CD edition includes one bonus track not available on the LP. The Ultimate Edition adds a large-format booklet containing a memoir titled “The Future Belongs to Analog Loyalists” by guitarist Mitsuru Tabata, a comic by Rob Syers, and a pull-out poster. Point Line Plane by Point Line Plane The lead single is “Death Dance 2000”, which has an official music video. About Point Line Plane Point Line Plane was formed in Portland, Oregon, around 2002 by vocalist and keyboardist Joshua Blanchard and drummer Nathan Carson as a synth-and-drums duo. Blanchard had previously performed as part of the Sensualists. Carson co-founded the Portland doom metal band Witch Mountain in 1997 and has run the booking agency Nanotear. The band’s self-titled debut was recorded and released in 2003, co-issued on CD by Xeroid Records and Sincere Brutality. That year the duo also released the single “Curse Chorus Curse / Sh…Boom” on S-S Records, contributed a cover of “Give The Future A Break” to a Screamers tribute compilation, and completed a split release with The Planet. In late 2003, Howard Gillam (also known as Supersprite) joined on second synth, expanding the lineup to a trio. As a trio, the band recorded “Smoke Signals,” released in 2004 on SKiN GRAFT Records. The band also produced the score for the feature documentary “Haunters.” Point Line Plane disbanded in 2005 after approximately 150 live performances. Both founding members continued other work. Blanchard also performs as Major Hex. Carson remained active with Witch Mountain, which has toured internationally and released records on Profound Lore Records and Svart Records. He also hosts The Heavy Metal Sewïng Cïrcle on XRAY FM, runs Nanotear Booking, and has published fiction. The original duo, Blanchard and Carson, announced their return in 2026 when SKiN GRAFT Records proposed the remastered vinyl reissue of the debut. “Point Line Plane” (SKiN GRAFT Records) is out now.
